params.caption: 🎮 NBA 2K27 gets a GTA 6 Vice City Edition Take-Two and 2K are bringing Vice City to the courts: NBA 2K27 Season 3 (Nov 27 – Jan 15) adds a Vice City-inspired Park, events like Conquer Leonida and Vice Run, and a $39.99 Vice City Edition on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC with a Season 3 Pro Pass and boosts. GTA+ members get the Standard Edition free for the season. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 19:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GameSpot · VGC 👥 @RockstarGames 🏀 React if you'd hoop in Vice City · 💬 Will you grab this edition? #NBA2K27 #GTA6 #TakeTwo #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
